description: Candidate rules. The engine evaluates every request against them and records where the outcome would differ (GET /policy/shadow-report), but never enforces them. To promote a rule, add the equivalent enforced rule to config/policy.json in a reviewed pull request, bump policy_version, and remove it here.

rules.description: Ported from agent-office/policies/shadow/memory_writes.cedar. Proposing long-term memory would itself wait for the operator, not only the promotion decision.
Candidate: refuse internal data updates touching more than 500 records instead of escalating them.
